name: Class-conditioned continuous graph-context teacher weights versus uniform all-classmate weights
mechanism: Replace positive-membership-only supervision by fixed unequal similarity targets within every TRAIN class, retaining all classmates so the auxiliary asks for relative context geometry; compare the predictive consequences to an identical all-classmate uniform target.
prior_collision: y-Aware and X-CLR continuous teacher weights as defined in2605.13943v1 §3.6
candidate_operation: For a later frozen comparison only, preserve one factual native SAGE forward, private route H, own CE+0.05aux, student cosine temperature0.2 and the same four fixed X,X-PX,PX,P²X signatures. For each route m, take every other same-class TRAIN node as a positive; Q_m(i,j) is proportional to exp(cos(signature_m(i),signature_m(j))/0.2) over those classmates. E(i) is all other TRAIN nodes. Use outside-log weighted CE with Q_m. No projector, adaptive teacher or extra trainable parameter. Zero signature vectors yield zero teacher cosine and corresponding equal pair weights; singleton-class rows, if any, are omitted from the auxiliary by a prospective declared rule.
decisive_control: Same information, same complete all-TRAIN denominator, same positive support, same own CE/aux scale, same member starts/optimizer/budget/selector: uniform Q over every other classmate. Therefore a difference can be attributed to the fixed pair weighting within this rule, not to adding/removing classmates or changing denominator support.
capable_references: Fresh equipped ordinary/factorized M1 and genuine independent I4 must each receive the complete mixture of all four weighted objectives; common-target shared control also receives that complete mixture. For this new common full denominator, averaging Q is algebraically equivalent to averaging complete objectives. This does not license Qbar+union-mask shortcuts for the currently frozen masked study. Exact roster and selection remain root decisions; no fit admitted here.
closest_shared_objective_comparator: MLCL is a documented prior alternative that puts context criteria into private auxiliary projections of one encoder. It is a prior/control requirement for a later claim about predictive recipients, not a second retained proposal or source change in this packet.
prediction: Weighted targets should acquire context-linked useful predictions beyond the uniform-all-classmate control while preserving mean/worst member competence and NLL; any proposed shared-allocation benefit must survive capable same-objective M1/I4/common-target comparisons.
refutation: No improvement beyond uniform-all-classmate weighting, or worse member competence/NLL, refutes this fixed predictive-utility hypothesis. A gain matched by same-information capable single/I4/common-objective references does not support a shared-recipient advantage. Lower auxiliary KL or more representation spread alone is insufficient.
realizability_and_optimization_limits: See GEOMETRY_AND_COLLAPSE_LIMITS.json. Teacher/student metric consistency and sufficient Gram rank can realize conditional ratios for free vectors; hard crossclass zeros prevent full entropic equality at finite cosine temperature. CE tradeoffs and native capacity remain. Parallel class vectors can be stationary/Jacobian-degenerate despite nonuniform targets; no collapse avoidance claim.
cost: No extra served/trainable parameters or factual GNN forwards. Four static580×580 teacher matrices are computed once; all-TRAIN similarity scores have the same quadratic dimension as current full-denominator arms. The minimal three-seed candidate versus uniform pair would require6fresh shared-bank fits if admitted; capable same-objective references require additional fresh fits. No wall-time estimate is inferred.
disposition: Conditional only; current source and running family frozen. Root chooses after complete evidence; no grid, implementation, scientific host, TEST, novelty or accuracy promise.
